entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana... I'm calling about my VeloBand Pulse. I'm hoping to return it, but I'm so worried I'm too late. I'm just really disappointed.
I'm sorry to hear that you're disappointed. To see how I can best assist, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the Pulse? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's just not for me, I guess. It doesn't feel right on my wrist. The problem is, I know I'm past the return date now. I'm just in a bit of a bind and I really needed this money back. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, I was hoping maybe there was something you could do.

I appreciate your loyalty with us, and I can certainly look into this. I see you received the VeloBand Pulse 18 days ago. I do want to be transparent that for this specific device, we have a strict 10-day return window due to hygiene and account activation protocols. Was there a reason you weren't able to initiate the return within those first 10 days?

That's the thing! I tried to. I went online on the ninth day to send it back, but there was a huge website error. The whole returns page just felt like the system was down. I must have refreshed it twenty times.
I see. Can you tell me the exact date you were trying to access the portal?

It was last week, on January 7th. I remember because I was so frustrated. I finally got to the last page to get the shipping label, but then I couldn't print it. The page just froze. I even took a screenshot of the error message because I was worried this exact thing would happen.

Thank you so much for that specific date, that's very helpful. Please hold one moment while I check our system alerts... Yes, I'm confirming it right now. We had a known server outage affecting our return portal for several hours on January 7th. I am so sorry you were affected by that; that is completely our fault.
Oh, thank goodness. So you can see it? I was so worried you would think I was just making an excuse.

I can absolutely see it, and no screenshot is necessary. Since our system down issue was the direct cause of the delay, I am definitely making an exception and processing this return for a full refund for you. I've just pushed it through. You should see an email with the prepaid return label in the next 5 to 10 minutes.

Also, I see on your account that you're a VIP member with us. To apologize for the website error and the stress this has caused, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. We really value your business and I hope we can make your next experience a better one.
Wow, Diana. That is such a relief. Thank you, thank you so much! I was so stressed about this. That's incredibly kind of you. You've really turned my day around.
It's my pleasure. I'm glad I could get this sorted out for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's everything. You've been wonderful. Thank you again!
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
